description: A small white square tray sits on a green surface with two block-like pillars already standing at the back corners, and a loose white pillar piece lies to the right. The left hand rests on the tray to steady it while the right hand reaches in from the right, picks up the loose pillar, moves it leftward over the tray, and presses it down onto the front-right corner slot, then releases as it stands upright.
